body:
## Project overview

Db2 Support RAG is a privacy-first support assistant that retrieves troubleshooting guidance with IBM Db2 vector search. It keeps filtering and ranking in Db2 so only retrieved context needs to leave the database boundary.

- Project slug: db2-support-rag
- Target audience: Db2 operators, developers, and support engineers

## IBM Db2 integration

- Db2 Community Edition 12.1.2+ or Db2 on IBM Cloud
- Python ibm_db connector
- VECTOR(8, FLOAT32) embeddings stored in DB2SUPPORT.SUPPORT_ARTICLES
- VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., COSINE) ranking inside Db2
- Optional category filtering and all user inputs passed as bound parameters

## Verification

- Run: python scripts/validate_submission.py submissions/db2-support-rag
- Run offline tests: python -m pytest submissions/db2-support-rag/tests -q
- Configure Db2 credentials from .env.example, then run seed.py
- Query with: python query.py "How do I resolve a deadlock?" --category transactions

## Checklist

- [x] New lowercase kebab-case submission folder
- [x] README, architecture, submission metadata, and environment template included
- [x] No secrets committed
- [x] Db2 integration is implemented in executable Python code
- [x] Offline validation checks passed

## Notes

The deterministic embedding baseline is dependency-light and reproducible for review. It can be replaced with watsonx.ai or another embedding model without changing the Db2 retrieval contract.
